scope: Validation-only correction for the already completed v237.1 causal Krylov-recycling run. The Case 7 data, operators, observations, fields, metrics, cache arrays, exact-call ledgers, summaries, controls, candidate, rank, depth, update rule, accuracy gates, and formal decision remain immutable.

observed_validator_defect.cause: The independent implementation intentionally rebuilds the PCGLS anchor through a separate floating-point path. v237 allowed 2e-9 for every formal-independent field comparison but imposed a stricter 1e-10 threshold on the frame-0 anchor, which is a subset of those same independently rebuilt fields. The stricter subset gate is internally inconsistent with the registered independent-field contract.
observed_validator_defect.scientific_distance_from_passing: The sealed primary has zero of thirteen complete rigs passing both absolute and matched gates, so this correction cannot turn a marginal scientific result into a pass. It can only resolve whether the already sealed negative is independently valid or remains inconclusive.

correction_rules.prior_inconclusive_tree: Bind and preserve the complete formal and first-validation arrays and reports. Never overwrite, relabel, or delete the prior inconclusive result.
correction_rules.anchor_recomputation: Directly compare the sealed first-validation primary frame-0 field for each of thirteen rigs with the sealed v235 zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS-K16 frame-0 reference field. Recompute the relative L2 values without importing either v237 implementation.
correction_rules.full_array_recomputation: Directly recompute the maximum formal-independent field relative difference, metric and cache maximum absolute differences, and exact call-ledger equality from the sealed arrays.
correction_rules.tolerance_source: The unchanged v237 formal-independent field-relative maximum already frozen before the v237 independent run. No new tolerance is selected from the observed anchor value.
correction_rules.decision_reconstruction: Derive the registered decision from the sealed independent summaries without importing the v237 decision helper. The primary already fails, so the only eligible recovered decision is FAIL_CASE7_CAUSAL_KRYLOV_RECYCLING_V237.
correction_rules.result_order: Any identity, seal, shape, dtype, finite-array, first-failure-shape, direct-difference, inherited-tolerance, unchanged-tree, or decision mismatch remains inconclusive. Only a complete pass may recover the sealed negative decision.
